title: My School Day
text:
My name is Lucia. I am a student at a big school. My favorite subject is science. We learn about animals and plants.

On Monday we have math and English. In English class we read stories and write words. My teacher is very friendly.

questions.text: What do they do in English class?
options: They read stories and write words

questions.text: How does Lucia probably feel about science?
What can we guess about Lucia's teacher?

vocabulary.definition: the study of the natural world through experiments
the subject that works with numbers
texts that describe events, real or imagined
a person who teaches students in a school

paragraph_translations: Me llamo Lucía. Soy estudiante en una escuela grande. Mi materia favorita es la ciencia. Aprendemos sobre animales y plantas.
El lunes tenemos matemáticas e inglés. En la clase de inglés leemos historias y escribimos palabras. Mi profesora es muy amable.
